questions.question: A car travels 120 km in 4 hours. Calculate its average speed in m/sec. [Give your answer correct to one decimal place.]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 120 km or 120000 m

Time = 4 hours = 4 × 3600 = 14400 s

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Speed = 120000/14400

⇒ S = 1200/144 = 8.3 m/s

**∴ Its average speed is 8.3 m/sec.**

questions.question: If the mean of five numbers 1, 2, 3, 5, and x is 2.4, then find the value of x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The mean of five numbers 1, 2, 3, 5, and x is 2.4

**Concept used:**

Mean = Sum of all terms/Total terms

**Calculations:**

Here, total terms = 5

According to the question,

(1 + 2 + 3 + 5 + x)/5 = 2.4

⇒ 11 + x = 2.4 × 5

⇒ 11 + x = 12

⇒ x = 12 - 11 = 1

**∴ The value of x is 1.**

questions.question: The radius of a sphere is 14 cm. What is the surface area of this sphere? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a sphere is 14 cm

**Formula used:**

The surface area of the sphere = 4 π r² 

**Calculations:**

SA = 4 × π × (14)² 

⇒ SA = 4 × 22/7 × (196) 

⇒ SA = 4 × 22 × 28 = 2464 cm² 

**∴ The surface area of this sphere is 2464 cm2.**

questions.question: A girl goes from M to N at a speed of 25 km/h and returns to M at a speed of 37.5 km/h, via the same route. What is the girl’s average speed (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A girl goes from M to N with the speed = 25 km/hr

The girl returns to M with the speed = 37.5 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = (2 × S1 × S2)/(S1 + S2)

Where, S1 is the speed from M to N and S2 is the speed from N to M

**Calculation:**

Average speed = (2 × S1 × S2)/(S1 + S2)

⇒ (2 × 25 × 37.5)/(25 + 37.5)

⇒ 1875/62.5 = 30 km/h

**∴ The girl’s average speed is 30 km/h.**

questions.question: The average marks of a student in six subjects was initially 110. After re-evaluation, in one subject the marks obtained was reduced from 148 to 112, while in the rest of the subjects the marks remained unchanged. What is the new average marks?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average marks of a student in six subjects was initially 110.

In one subject the marks obtained was reduced from 148 to 112

**Concept used:**

Average value = Sum of all the value/Total no. of values

**Calculations:**

Let the sum of 5 subjects is 5x.

According to the question,

Original Average value,

⇒ 110 = (5x + 148)/6

⇒ 660 = 5x + 148

⇒ 5x = 512

When the marks of one of the subject are changed then the average value

⇒ A = (5x + 112)/6

⇒ A = (512 + 112)/6

⇒ A = 624/6 = 104

**∴ The new average mark is 104.**

questions.question: 15 men can do a work in 15 days working 8 hours a day. N men can do twice the work in 20 days working 10 hours a day. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

M1 = 15, D1 = 15, H₁ = 8 and

M₂ = N, D2 = 20, H2 = 10

**Concept used:**

(M1D1H1)/W1 = (M2D2H2)/W2 

M₁ = men or women in first group

D1 = days to complete the work by first group

H1 = working hours in a day by first group

W1 = work done by first group

M2 = men or women in second group

D2 = days to complete the work by second group

H2 = working hours in a day by second group.

W2 = work done by second group

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

2(W1) = W2 

Then,

(15 × 15 × 8)/(W1) = (N × 20 × 10)/2(W1)

⇒ 2(15 × 15 × 8) = (N × 20 × 10)

⇒ 2(1800) = N × 200

⇒ 3600 = N × 200

⇒ N = 3600/200 = 18

**∴ The value of N is 18.**

questions.question: In an election between 2 candidates, the winning candidate got 55% of the valid votes. 5% of the total votes were invalid. If the total number of votes polled were 10000, then how many votes were obtained by the losing candidate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The winning candidate got 55% of the valid votes. 

5% of the total votes were invalid. 

The total number of votes polled were 10000

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total no. of valid votes 

⇒ 95% of 10000 

⇒ 0.95 × 10000 = 9500

Now total votes of winning candidate,

⇒ 55% of 9500

⇒ 0.55 × 9500 = 5225

Now Total votes of Loosing candidate = 9500 - 5225 = 4275

**∴ 4275 votes were obtained by the losing candidate.**

questions.question: Find the smallest natural number ‘x’ that must be subtracted from 1800 so that (1800 - x), when divided by 7, 11 and 23, will leave 5 as the remainder in each case.
questions.solution:
**Calculations:**

Step 1 - Take LCM (7, 11, 23) = 1771

Step 2 - Divide 1800 by 1771.

⇒ 1800 ÷ 1771 = 1 (quotient) and 29 (remainder)

Step 3 - To get 5 as remainder you must subtract 24.

⇒ 29 – 24 = 5

Result : 1800 – 24 = 1776

⇒ 1776 ÷ 7 = 253 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

⇒ 1776 ÷ 11 = 161 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

⇒ 1776 ÷ 23 = 77 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

**∴ The smallest natural number ‘x’ must be 24.**

questions.question: A train can completely cross a 1000-metre long bridge in 15 seconds. It can completely cross another 1300-metre long bridge in 19 seconds. What is the length of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train can completely cross a 1000-metre long bridge in 15 seconds. 

It can completely cross another 1300-metre long bridge in 19 seconds.

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be 'x'

According to the question,

(1000 + x)/15 = (1300 + x)/19

⇒ (1000 + x) × 19 = (1300 + x) × 15

⇒ 19000 + 19x = 19500 + 15x

⇒ 4x = 500

⇒ x = 500/4 = 125 m

**∴ The length of the train is 125 m.**

questions.question: A sum of money, when invested at the rate of 6.25% simple interest per annum, amounts to (11)/(8) times of itself in ‘n’ years. What is the value of ‘n’?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 6.25% per annum

Time = n years

Amount = 11/8 × Principle

**Concept used:**

SI = A - P

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

Let the Principle sum be 'x'

S.I. = A − P

⇒ SI = 11/8P − P

⇒ SI = (11P - 8P)/8 = 3P/8

Now SI

3x/8 = (x × 6.25 × n)/100

⇒ 300/8 = 6.25n

⇒ n = 300/(8 × 6.25)

⇒ n = 300/50 = 6 years

**∴ The value of ‘n’ is 6 years.**
